notes: Unlike claude-code / opencode, the Codex CLI is a Rust binary shipped through npm: the JS entry point only locates and execs it. The vendored artifact is x86_64-unknown-linux-musl and static-pie linked, so it runs unchanged on both glibc and musl task containers.
That removes the dual-ABI node build the other runtimes need: no node, no libc shims, no runtime-select-node.sh. The image is FROM scratch and carries only the vendor tree.
Consumed as a k8s ImageVolume; only the subpath opt/custom-agent-runtime/codex is mounted into the task pod.
The matching agent class is harbor_patch.agents.image_mounted_codex:Codex, which detects the mount and skips the in-pod npm install.
